# codemie Provider

Manage CodeMie assistants, workflows, and skills.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "codemie" {
  # Prefer CODEMIE_HOST, CODEMIE_TOKEN_URL, CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID,
  # and CODEMIE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID. May be set with CODEMIE_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret. May be set with CODEMIE_CLIENT_SECRET.
- `host` (String) CodeMie API base URL. May be set with CODEMIE_HOST.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint. May be set with CODEMIE_TOKEN_URL.
